description: Model output for pointer extraction on a paystub skeleton. Values are placeholder references or closed enums, never document text. x-kind tells the Rehydrator how to read each field.

employerName.description: Employer (company) name: the hidden-word ids of the name, in reading order

employeeName.description: Employee's name: the hidden-word ids of the name, in reading order

payFrequency.description: How often the employee is paid

payDate.description: Date the pay was issued (pay date or check date)

periodStart.description: First day of the pay period

periodEnd.description: Last day of the pay period

grossPay.description: Total gross pay for this pay period (current column, not year to date)

netPay.description: Net pay for this pay period, the amount paid to the employee (also called take home pay)

ytdGross.description: Total gross pay year to date (YTD column)

hoursWorked.description: Regular hours worked in this pay period

deductions.description: Every deduction or withholding line, with its amount for this pay period (not year to date)
